title: Machine intelligence on wireless edge networks — data and code
description:
Data and code underlying the figures, tables and reported numbers of the manuscript Machine intelligence on wireless edge networks (Jia, Vadlamani, Sulimany, Morag, Gao, Wang, Chen and Englund).

The package is split into the two trees that the Data availability and Code availability statements refer to:

  • Data_availability/ — measured and simulated source data behind every main-text figure, supplementary figure, supplementary table and supplementary note, plus the upstream acquisition and training campaigns under raw/.
  • Code_availability/ — the acquisition, analysis and figure-generation code, mirroring the data tree exactly: figure_scripts/ pairs with the per-figure data folders and pipelines/ pairs with Data_availability/raw/.

Every script resolves its own data folder through _paths.data_dir(__file__), so a fresh clone runs without configuration. All simulations are CPU-only and use fixed seeds.

Licensing is split: the source code is released under the MIT License (see LICENSE) and the data, figures and documentation under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA). The GTSRB and MNIST caches redistributed here derive from their original public distributions and remain subject to those datasets' own terms.

One file, Data_availability/raw/fully_analog_simulation/data/gtsrb_roi_32x32.npz (127 MB), is stored with Git LFS in the GitHub repository; it is included in full in this archive.
